decision.observation: Entrant 4 still stands at the window after taking his denied passport; the M.O.A. CITATION reading 'Applicant clear for entry. WARNING ISSUED - NO PENALTY' remains on the desk, along with the contraband ad card.
decision.hypothesis: Like Ava, he may be waiting on an unprocessed document, or the citation may indicate he should have been granted entry — watching whether he leaves on his own first.
decision.memory: Citations appear when protocol is violated; 'Applicant clear for entry' suggests the ministry overrides a missing-document denial.
